category.name: Range
category.preferred_workflow: Create a Document, optionally add sections or other nodes, obtain the appropriate Aspose.Words.Range instance, perform the required operation using documented methods (e.g., Range.Text for read-only extraction, Range.Replace for substitution, BookmarkCollection, FormFields, or FindReplaceOptions), and finally save the document to a deterministic local path.

strict_api_bans: Do not reference members that are not present in Aspose.Words 26.11.0.
Do not import or use System.Range when Aspose.Words.Range is required.
canonical_patterns: Use DocumentBuilder for content creation and for inserting bookmarks, form fields, or text.
Use Section.Range.Text or Node.Range.Text for plain-text extraction; use Range.Replace for modifications.
Iterate over collections (Bookmarks, FormFields) directly from doc.Range without invoking non-existent Add or constructor overloads.
nullable_warning_prevention: Check that objects such as Section, HeaderFooter, or BookmarkStart are not null before accessing their properties.
Validate that a document contains at least one section before iterating over Section.Range.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: The compiler reports "'Range' is an ambiguous reference between 'Aspose.Words.Range' and 'System.Range'".
common_failure_patterns.cause: Both System.Range (C# 8) and Aspose.Words.Range are imported, and the code does not qualify the type.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Fully qualify the Aspose.Words.Range type or add an alias (e.g., using AwRange = Aspose.Words.Range).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always import Aspose.Words.Range with an explicit alias when System.Range is also in scope.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS1061 or CS1729 indicating missing methods such as HeaderFooter.IsFooter, BookmarkCollection.Add, Range.InsertBefore, or assigning to Range.Text.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code assumes APIs that were never part of the documented library version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace the call with the correct documented alternative (e.g., use HeaderFooter.HeaderFooterType to identify footers, use DocumentBuilder.StartBookmark/EndBookmark instead of BookmarkCollection.Add, use DocumentBuilder.Write or InsertAfter on a Paragraph for insertion, and use Range.Replace for text changes).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the official Aspose.Words API reference for the exact member signatures before coding.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0234 or CS0103 errors for types like TextFormFieldType, Builders, or BuildingBlocks.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code references enums or namespaces that either belong to a different version or were misspelled.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Import Aspose.Words.Fields and use the correct enum values (e.g., TextFormFieldType.Regular) and correct namespaces (Aspose.Words.BuildingBlocks).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Verify enum names and namespaces against the 26.11.0 documentation and enable IntelliSense to avoid typographical errors.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime NullReferenceException or compile-time errors when loading a document that has not been saved first.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The example attempts to load or process a file that was never created in the sandbox.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create the required document, sections, or other resources programmatically before loading or processing them.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always generate a deterministic sample document at the start of the program and reference that file for subsequent operations.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: The program checks unrelated document internals, causing failures unrelated to the task.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Validation logic is not scoped to the specific operation being demonstrated.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Limit assertions to the existence of the output file and to the direct result of the performed Range operation.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Design validation steps that verify only the behavior described in the task.

narrative.overview: The Range category demonstrates how to manipulate document content using Aspose.Words.Range and related node-scoped APIs. Verified examples cover extracting plain text, counting and renaming bookmarks, handling form fields, and performing case-insensitive searches with callbacks.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding assistant with concise, reproducible patterns for safe Range operations, ensuring that all inputs are created locally, only documented APIs are used, and output files are persisted.
validation_priorities: Confirm that the generated code compiles against Aspose.Words 26.11.0 and that the expected output file exists after execution.
maintenance_notes: Periodically run the verified examples against the latest Aspose.Words package to detect API deprecations and update the canonical patterns accordingly.
